source: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), api.openstreetmap.org: building ways in the strip; ground from the USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM, CA_SanFrancisco_B23 tile x54y419 (public domain).
datum: ground is NAVD88 m less 0.969 m (mean sea level, the drawn water)
flags: bits 0-1: 3 lidar roof height (--lidar), 2 OSM height, 1 levels x 3.3 m, 0 default by type; bit 2 (4): no DEM ground, on a 3 m deck; bit 3 (8): the Marin shore, ground from the terrain at run time
